news_items.headline: Rockwell Automation Q2 EPS $3.30 beats $2.88 consensus; raises FY26 EPS view to $12.50-$13.10
news_items.summary: Q2 FY26 adjusted EPS $3.30 vs $2.88 consensus; revenue $2.24B vs ~$2.16-2.18B expected. Management raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $12.50-$13.10 and FY26 revenue outlook to ~$8.9B.

news_items.headline: ROK stock surges 5.4% on May 6 after strong earnings beat
news_items.summary: ROK closed +5.4% at $459.35 on 2026-05-06 following the Q2 beat. Stock outpaced industrial sector gains and trades near 52-week highs.

news_items.headline: Rockwell Automation up 8.6% after raising 2026 guidance on strong Q2 results
news_items.summary: Catalysts cited: data centers, semiconductors, energy verticals converting strong orders into higher-margin growth. Updated FY26 outlook ran ahead of analyst expectations.

news_items.headline: HSBC issues positive forecast for Rockwell Automation; raises price target to $490
news_items.summary: HSBC raised its price target on ROK from $445 to $490 on 2026-05-07. Goldman, BNP Paribas, and Evercore also raised forecasts and price targets following Q2.

news_items.headline: Rockwell Automation Surges After Blowout Earnings Beat
news_items.summary: TipRanks coverage of ROK's blowout Q2 beat-and-raise; multiple sell-side firms raised price targets following results.

news_items.headline: Insider sale: SVP Matthew Fordenwalt sells 600 shares of ROK at $449.58
news_items.summary: SVP Matthew Fordenwalt sold 600 shares on 2026-05-05 at avg $449.58 ($269,748 total). Small relative size; transaction date matches Q2 earnings release day.

news_items.headline: Insider sale: SVP Lifecycle Services of ROK sells 460 shares
news_items.summary: Additional insider sale of 460 shares (SVP Lifecycle Services). Small size relative to total shares outstanding; same-day as Q2 results.

news_items.headline: ROK moved up 10.72% on May 5
news_items.summary: ROK gained 10.72% on 2026-05-05 on the day of the Q2 earnings release.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: HSBC raised PT to $490 on 2026-05-07. Goldman, BNP Paribas, Evercore also raised price targets on 2026-05-05/06 following Q2 beat-and-raise. Consensus remains Buy / Moderate Buy (19 buy / 2 hold / 0 sell on one panel; 15 buy / 14 hold / 1 sell on a 26-analyst panel). Note: 12-month avg PT of $428.66 sits below the post-earnings price ~$459, suggesting targets are still catching up.

earnings_context.notes: Q2 FY26 reported 2026-05-05: EPS $3.30 vs $2.88-2.92 est; revenue $2.24B vs $2.16-2.18B est. Strength in data centers, semiconductors, energy, warehouse automation. FY26 guide raised to $12.50-$13.10 EPS / ~$8.9B revenue vs prior consensus ~$12.26. Next print scheduled August 5, 2026 — well outside any near-term blackout window.
